result: Added `scenes/bullet.tscn` (Area2D with a radius-4 circle shape) and `scripts/bullet.gd`, which moves the bullet up at 600 px/s, calls `hit(1)` on enemies and frees itself. The collision mask is set to the enemies layer only, so it passes through the player. Godot isn't installed here, so the scene is unverified in-engine; the script passed godot_review with no findings.
